annotations.title: Add a job to the cart

description: Prices one job with Printdash's pricing engine (product id and a configuration of option ids, as price_job takes them) and puts it in the cart exactly as the product page's Add to cart does. If the job cannot be priced, nothing is added and the result says what is missing or the nearest combinations. Nothing is ordered or charged: checkout on printdash.io re-prices, takes artwork and payment. Printdash prints in Australia and delivers within Australia only; prices are in AUD and include GST. Needs a signed-in Printdash account: called without one, the connection asks the customer to sign in on printdash.io.

configuration.description: The job, as option ids from get_product. Everything optional: the result says what is missing.

attributeSelections.description: Simple products: attribute name to the chosen value's label.

coverStockId.description: Booklets: cover stock id, or self for a self cover.

designs.description: Several different designs with the same specs on one item, where get_product offers designs.

finishingIds.description: Finishing option ids, from every finishing field the customer chose.

height.description: Custom finished height in mm (with width).

pages.description: Booklets: page count, one of the pages field's presets.

quantity.description: How many. With designs above 1, how many of EACH design.

sizeId.description: A preset size id from get_product's size field. Or give width and height for a custom size.

stickerShape.description: Where get_product has a sticker_shape field: an id from it. Stickers: square, circle or custom; labels: rectangle, circle or custom.

stockId.description: Stock id from the stock field.

width.description: Custom finished width in mm (with height), within the size field's limits.
